qualitative.variation_notes: Length ranges from one- or two-line quips and position updates to long essays of a dozen or more short paragraphs (timelines, life reflections, campaign write-ups). The register shifts from slangy and joking to earnest and reflective within the same donor. Hook types vary as well: most posts start with a plain claim, but anecdote, alert, question and quote openings all appear. Donors differ in their mix: some lean toward equities and earnings, others toward on-chain speculation, promotions or lifestyle content.
qualitative.judgment_style: Views are usually stated in the first person and fairly assertively ('I think', 'most likely'), often with a conditional premise attached (if you believe X, then Y is worth watching) instead of formal hedging. Data is used selectively to support a read the author already holds, not as exhaustive evidence. Admissions of losses, missed entries or uncertainty are common and do not weaken the main lean. Explicit promotional content is the exception and is upbeat, without caveats.

compliance_removed: Openly discloses the author's own position or trade (bought, fully positioned, chased higher) instead of speaking only in the abstract
Posts usually lead with the author's own observation or position, use a few numbers as support, and finish with a brief takeaway that is often wry or self-deprecating.
